title: see: An R Package for Visualizing Statistical Models
authors: Lüdecke, D., Patil, I., Ben-Shachar, M., Wiernik, B., Waggoner, P., & Makowski, D.
summary: see is the plotting half of easystats: it takes what the other packages return — model checks, effect sizes, posteriors, correlation matrices, cluster solutions — and draws it, so that a diagnostic is looked at rather than read off a table.
